bug: unassigned / lost-subnet devices kept previously installed blocks (차단이 안 풀림)
cause: forAgent() fell back to forDevice(), which had no acl_apply. The device could not tell "no rules" from "this cycle sent nothing".
fix: forDevice() now appends an EMPTY acl_apply (declarative release) built by BatchPolicyContext.release(vendor, product), only while automatic enforcement is on.
scope: Only strategies that implement batchEnforcementRule receive it: OVS switch + router. Firewall and VM return null, so the externally managed firewall nft rules (astra_cso) are never touched.
external_mode: automaticEnforcementEnabled=false still sends NO acl_apply, so deployments where external tooling owns the rules are unaffected.
reviewer_note: Unassigned routers now carry a harmless SONAR-CSO chain containing only RETURN + a FORWARD jump. That scoped chain is precisely what lets us clear our own drops without touching other tools.
